content: Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and to address your specific health needs. Storage Instructions: Store this product at room temperature, ensuring it is kept away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice and should not substitute for the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To access formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
